tasks.gr11-cash-budgets-t3: Topic: Cash Budgets. Cover cash budget format and purpose, cash receipts, cash payments, debtors collection schedules, creditors payment schedules, and the analysis of projected cash shortfalls or surpluses. Ask Grade 11 learners to complete or correct a cash budget, prepare a debtors collection schedule, or explain the implications of a projected cash deficit.
tasks.gr11-projected-financial-statements-t3: Topic: Projected Financial Statements. Cover the projected statement of comprehensive income, budget assumptions, variance identification, and the effect of changing assumptions on projected results. Ask Grade 11 learners to prepare a projected income statement from budget data, calculate budget variances, or explain how a change in selling price affects projected profit.
tasks.gr11-inventory-systems-stock-valuation-t: Topic: Inventory Systems and Stock Valuation. Cover the periodic and perpetual inventory systems, the FIFO and weighted average cost (WAC) valuation methods, and their effect on closing stock and gross profit. Ask Grade 11 learners to calculate closing stock value under different methods, compare profit outcomes, or explain advantages of each inventory system.
tasks.gr11-manufacturing-costs-break-even-t3: Topic: Manufacturing Costs and Break-Even. Cover direct materials, direct labour, factory overheads, unit cost of production, break-even point calculations, and the production cost statement. Ask Grade 11 learners to classify manufacturing costs, calculate unit production cost, determine the break-even point, or prepare a production cost statement.
